# create

Create a new column (attribute) on a Dataverse table

## Usage

```
ppds column create [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--date-time-behavior` |  | `string` |  | DateTime behavior: UserLocal, DateOnly, or TimeZoneIndependent |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--default-value` |  | `int?` |  | Default value for Choice or Boolean columns |
| `--description` |  | `string` |  | Description of the column |
| `--display-name` |  | `string` |  | Display name of the column |
| `--dry-run` |  | `bool` |  | Validate only, do not persist changes |
| `--entity` | `-e` | `string` |  | Logical name of the entity to add the column to |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--false-label` |  | `string` |  | Label for the false value of a Boolean column |
| `--format` |  | `string` |  | Format for String, Integer, or DateTime columns |
| `--max-length` |  | `int?` |  | Maximum length for String/Memo columns |
| `--max-size-kb` |  | `int?` |  | Maximum file size in KB for Image/File columns |
| `--max-value` |  | `double?` |  | Maximum value for numeric columns |
| `--min-value` |  | `double?` |  | Minimum value for numeric columns |
| `--name` |  | `string` |  | Schema name for the new column (e.g., new_MyColumn) |
| `--option-set-name` |  | `string` |  | Name of an existing global option set for Choice/Choices columns |
| `--options` |  | `string` |  | Option definitions for Choice/Choices columns: "Label1=1,Label2=2" |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--precision` |  | `int?` |  | Precision for Decimal, Double, and Money columns |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--required-level` |  | `string` |  | Requirement level: None, Recommended, or Required |
| `--solution` | `-s` | `string` |  | Solution unique name containing the table |
| `--true-label` |  | `string` |  | Label for the true value of a Boolean column |
| `--type` |  | `SchemaColumnType` |  | Column type: String, Memo, Integer, BigInt, Decimal, Double, Money, Boolean, DateTime, Choice, Choices, Image, File, Lookup |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
